scope: Additional playback Worker deformation-cell reuse and UV gradient packing optimization. Existing uncommitted changes and previous audit reports are retained.

rootCausesAndChanges.cause: Changing parent transforms repeatedly normalized and classified unchanged local vertices. Instrumented 360-frame sample: 10,374,734 of 12,437,172 XY pairs retained their bitwise input.
rootCausesAndChanges.change: Retain per-pair grid-cell descriptors; recompute them when the bitwise input or mapper length changes. Read current-version parent grid samples every mapping. Float64 operation order and signed zeros are unchanged.

rootCausesAndChanges.cause: Every UV triangle recomputed packed source offsets and the provoking vertex lookup.
rootCausesAndChanges.change: Retain Uint32 packed offsets by source index revision and active vertex count; reuse high-water capacity across animated culling. Advance output cursors once per triangle and reuse the first/third source offset.

rootCausesAndChanges.cause: Each gradient buffer update included original shared vertices, whose flat gradient attributes are never sampled.
rootCausesAndChanges.change: Update only the appended provoking-vertex suffix; skip empty uploads. GPU buffer allocation remains large enough for the indexed attributes.

workerMappingCPU.method: Replay actual frame-121 deformation map_vertices calls against captured document memory; thread CPU time excludes OS descheduling. Parent samples are already current; does not measure full Worker or parent-grid updates.
workerMappingCPU.interpretation: This isolates warm map_vertices calls at actual frame 121. It excludes parent-grid refresh, JS playback/physics/Glue, packet handling, transport and rendering; it is not a full Worker speed claim.

workerRoundTrip.interpretation: The full Worker round trip did not show a reproducible improvement. Keep the isolated mapping result separate from end-to-end throughput; both variants were approximately equal amid run-to-run variation.

uvPacking.method: Chrome, actual captured 19 batch geometries; 2,000 warmup iterations per variant, then 6 ABBA samples per variant, each packing the complete frame 1,000 times inside one continuous browser task. Includes copies and Jacobian computation; excludes topology rebuild and GPU upload.

additionalScales.method: Separate synthetic Chrome benchmark with 2,000 warmup iterations per variant and six ABBA samples per variant at each scale. Complete source/gradient output bits match.

gpuGradientUpload.nativeRegression: Real WebGL bufferSubData test verifies a deformed quad uploads 32 bytes at destination offset 64, instead of 96 bytes from offset 0. The full-model byte counts are derived from the observed active geometry counts, not a direct model-wide driver counter.

playbackFPS.metric: Updated model frames per second; not a measurement of physical monitor presentation. rAF Hz is reported separately.

quality.controlsAndState: Matched at deterministic checkpoints, including input bursts, document replacement, buffering off/on, resize and renderer recreation.

cost.ownership: Offsets follow each geometry high-water capacity and are released on destruction. Deformation descriptors are allocated with mapper buffers and released with their document-owned Wasm instance.

longRun.note: 13,200 numeric frames including warmup use exactly the final Worker binary. The long renderer run precedes the final offset-capacity reuse edit; do not attribute its player hash to the final artifact.

memory.limits: CDP retained heap/backing storage and logical resource counts are measured. Driver VRAM/RSS is not measured; this is not an assertion about all browser/GPU allocators.

unitSuite.note: Full suite passed before the last geometry capacity-reuse refinement; affected final tests were rerun afterward.

browserMetal.skipReason: Optional Rust renderer fixture generators, not WebGPU verification.

measurementNotes: All model data and benchmarks ran locally. No model was uploaded.
Rendering baselines include the earlier Pixi lifetime fixes; this report isolates the additional current optimization.

Some comparison runs stalled after saving passed results while awaiting Playwright browser cleanup. Temporary measurement harnesses explicitly close pages and release owned Chrome output pipes only after the Chrome process exits; this does not change code or timing inside the player.
No low-end physical CPU matrix or WebGPU throughput benchmark was executed.
